account.loginIntro: Sign in to see your pets’ profiles.
account.registerIntro: Create an account and add your first pet.
account.passwordHint: 12–128 characters. Use a different password from your email account.
account.emptyText: Start with a name and species. You can add a photo and more details later.
account.privateHint: Your account starts without demo pets. Only you can access your profiles.
account.name: Name
account.requiredHint: Fields marked with an asterisk are required. Everything else is optional.
account.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB, 8192 px per side and 25 megapixels. The crop is applied when you save.
account.deleteText: The profile for {{name}} and its photo will be permanently deleted. Personal accounts do not yet have linked tasks, feeding or health records. The demo will stay unchanged.

notConnected.today: Personal tasks are not connected to the database yet. No sample tasks are shown here. Try the schedule in the separate demo.
notConnected.food: Your feeding journal will be added in a later stage. Sample feedings are available in the demo.
notConnected.health: Personal health records are not connected yet. Example visits are available in the demo.
